workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've read Priya and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots where both are free:

- Monday: 9:00, 9:30
- Tuesday: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
- Wednesday: 15:00, 15:30
- Thursday: 10:00, 14:30
- Friday: 11:00, 11:30

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and tell me which of these slots work for them? Or if you prefer, let me know their free times and I'll find the overlap.

Thanks!

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I checked Elena and David's calendars against the slots you provided. After going through each one, there is only one slot where all four partners are available:

**Thursday at 14:30 (2:30 PM - 3:00 PM)**

All other slots you listed have conflicts with either Elena or David. Please go ahead and book this time in the booking system. Once confirmed, I'll send the confirmation email to all four partners.
